faq.q: What are the Leonida Keys in GTA 6?
faq.a: The Leonida Keys are an officially named tropical archipelago within Leonida. Rockstar's official screenshot library contains a dedicated Leonida Keys set, and its artwork library includes a Leonida Keys postcard.

faq.q: Which characters are connected to the Leonida Keys?
faq.a: Rockstar's Only in Leonida material links Jason Duval to work in the Keys and identifies Brian Heder as a drug runner operating there.

faq.q: What does the environment look like in the Leonida Keys?
faq.a: Public material shows low islands, causeways, water, boats and coastal environments, reflecting the archipelago's tropical island setting within GTA 6.

faq.q: When were the Leonida Keys first shown in GTA 6?
faq.a: The Leonida Keys first appeared in Trailer 2, released on 6 May 2025.

faq.q: How many islands make up the Leonida Keys?
faq.a: Rockstar has not published a definitive island-by-island list, exact boundaries, or official coordinates for the Keys, so the total number of islands has not been confirmed.
